citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
The facility did not perform complete daily observation of all animals to assess their health and well-being. On
examination of an adult male beagle, Bogie (chip # 978101081154294) the APHIS official noted significant dental tarter
build up on the teeth. The facility representative had not noted this tarter previously and there was no record of this tarter
in his medical record.
The facility had not identified this condition prior to the inspection. This has prevented the attending veterinarian from the
opportunity to provide timely medical care for the animal.
Bogie was added to the dental cleaning list for the attending veterinarian that was occurring the day following the
inspection.
Daily observations of all animals to assess their health and well-being must be throughly performed from this date
forward, August 5, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
